interpretation: GSK prototype 1 ended with the screen locked; prototypes 2 and 3 observed locked endpoints. These runs do not decide unlocked-desktop performance. Prototype 3 foreground callback excludes GPU lines/arrows and cannot be directly compared to the earlier full-Cairo callback timer. The final trial has a 252ms p95 outlier; its cause has not been established.
